camera_cases: 5 mounted/external pivots, clamps, dolly, resets, fresh host equality; malformed response rejection; total, annular, partial and behind-source eclipse geometry; explicit seat and berth operations, tether bound, push, drift and paused crew freeze; seat-transition flight-key latch for vessel axes and crew walk; push on a fresh g only, dropped while paused or in help, q never pushes; developer-only pause cuts throttle, drops unsent commands and locks console management; help leaves simulation running; mouse slider drags and clamps with explicit cut; worst-case flight column and crew aid text within bounds; camera keys excluded from vessel axes; unstrap, reseat and override throttle clearing and gate; last accepted throttle validation; six audio files parsed without playback; route gates on a labelled synthetic display: seated secured, override emergency, unseated free, engage only on host go with acknowledged restraint, advance held on stale restraint or host work; resume and assist held with a stated reason during host work, escape stops work explicitly and changes nothing when idle; a notice raised during a forecast ends with it and the live status returns; a ready forecast refuses a fresh forecast locally and needs a second resume; an accepted engage with no input made while it was in flight latches axis keys held from before the send until release and cuts the local throttle, paused route steering shows the last actual command; a host takeover by manual input is acknowledged; recovery pauses, cuts throttle and drops a queued engage, and only host pointer names pass the pipe; a cut or throttle step takes over only an engaged route, drops a queued engage with a notice and leaves a running or held forecast alone; escape names a dropped queued restore and says a running forecast continues; unseated throttle without override says why and changes nothing; soft-key hit boxes are the drawn 2 x 2 keys and their gaps are inert; dimmed soft keys change nothing when clicked; with no route the route keys and escape change nothing; route transport validation on synthetic replies; live route presence matches the startup scenario; mission selection queues one fixed-word request, names a dropped queued restore, keeps a queued save first, holds resume, assist and route keys, escape drops it, and only an accepted reply changes the scenario and resets route queue, controls and restraint sync; an engage sent and unanswered keeps a throttle change or cut made meanwhile and queues a takeover behind an accepted reply, and leaves the forecast alone when refused, camera and help input never count; an accepted mission change claims nothing about a retained flight; berth and override refuse running or queued host work, berth keeps a queued route request or mission change, and the top status, plate and footer name the work and never offer resume, berth or override while they cannot act; the unseated plate keeps its default slot at the unstrapped spot and leaves the displays clear at the berth; progress fields refuse malformed, partial, out-of-range and inconsistent groups without changing outputs, accept an absent group as unknown, and display shares stay below 100 percent; a refused advance pauses with a notice only for its own sequence and operation; route event words; restore-source pointer allowed for recover only
